corpus_grew_since_exp4547.note: corpus regenerated ~11.8x larger since exp4547; exp4547's 0.709 is the PRIOR-corpus number, cited not reproduced; CNN AUROC re-measured on current corpus.

field_principles.action_id_only_auroc: the adversarial control (exp5727 methodology) -- per-action-id empirical change rate from TRAIN applied to HELDOUT; the 'free' trivial signal every agent has. CNN-seed-independent.
field_principles.click_head_within_action_discrimination: click_head AUROC with action_id fixed at 6 (base rate constant), ACROSS SEEDS vs an untrained control -- the one signal a per-action-type base rate structurally cannot explain, but only if stable across seeds and beating the untrained structural baseline.
field_principles.cnn_held_out_delta_auroc: the number exp4547 reported vs bare chance, RE-MEASURED (mean over seeds) on the current corpus so the base-rate control is directly comparable; exp4547's value is cited separately.
field_principles.directional_head_within_action_discrimin: per-directional-action-id AUROC with action id held fixed, across seeds vs untrained -- tests per-frame (not base-rate) discrimination for the pooled directional head.
field_principles.duration_s: wall-clock of corpus load + multi-seed CNN train + forward passes; no LLM/GPU, 1s floor.
field_principles.false_negative_risk_checked: a null is valid only with the positive control passed AND the seed-robustness check done (so a real-but-unstable signal is not mistaken for no signal, nor seed luck for signal).
field_principles.frame_adds_over_action_id: THE HEADLINE -- mean cnn_auroc minus the action-id base rate. Near-zero/negative means the CNN AUROC is a per-action-type base rate, NOT frame-content discrimination.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; complete: base-rate mirage (frame adds ~0, no robust within-action signal across seeds) matching exp5727, OR complete: a head carries robust learned signal.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- trains/scores a small CPU CNN against cached replay transitions, no GGUF/LLM load (1s floor).
field_principles.model_specs: names the real compute substrate actually run -- the SmallFrameChangeCNN torch CNN (no LLM); required so a third party can re-run the exact model under audit.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: the AUROC harness is functional (training reduces loss AND the machinery can produce above-chance AUROCs when structure exists) -- guards against a null from a broken harness.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records resources verified (torch, corpus cached) before the run.
field_principles.random_seed: primary determinism seed (exp4547's 4547); full seed set in `seeds`.
field_principles.recommendation: is there ANY real, robust, non-base-rate signal worth building on, and WHERE (click_head vs directional_head), or is the scorer a base-rate/seed-luck mirage matching exp5727?
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of inputs+metrics; catches silent corpus/model drift.
field_principles.seed_robustness: the load-bearing rigor field -- a within-action AUROC is only a real learned signal if it clears the floor on the WORST seed; a lone-seed high value is seed luck, not signal.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: false -- the label is raw pixel-change ground truth, oracle-DISTINCT from the LEARNED CNN scoring the frames; no moat/gate claim is made.

model_specs.architecture: 3x Conv2d(3x3) feature stack -> click_head (1x1 conv per-pixel heatmap) + directional_head (adaptive-avg-pool -> Linear, 5 outputs)
model_specs.name: SmallFrameChangeCNN
model_specs.note: no GGUF/LLM invoked; this IS the cached-candidate CNN scorer whose held-out AUROC is under audit (the substrate is verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates, not model inference).
model_specs.trained_on: balanced 4096-example subset of the current human-replay corpus, 1 epoch, Adam lr=0.01, retrained per seed

exp4547_frame_change_predictor.role: the original 0.709-vs-CHANCE (0.5 hardcoded) measurement this re-controls; its own final verdict was already an action-reduction null.

exp4568_clickability_action_effect_predi.role: earlier clickability-predictor null (actions_delta 0.0) -- same no-live-gain pattern.

exp5727_perception_action_effect_adequac.role: the base-rate control methodology applied here; found frame_adds_over_action_id=-0.039 for the LINEAR classifier on the same action-effect target.

exp5728_cnn_weight_sweep.role: why this matters -- weight sweep null localized the gate, not the weight.

exp5729_gtv_gate_fix_ab.role: why this matters -- loosening the gate turned the scorer ON (~27k consults on lp85) yet search was byte-identical; localized the blocker to scorer signal quality, which THIS experiment characterizes as a base-rate/seed-luck mirage.

recommendation: NO robust, non-base-rate signal anywhere in the CNN. (1) frame_adds_over_action_id is ~0/negative (mean -0.010): the held-out AUROC does not beat the action-id base rate, same finding as exp5727's linear classifier. (2) The click_head's within-action AUROC is seed-UNSTABLE (min 0.44399, max 0.918057 across 5 seeds) and does not reliably beat its own untrained structural baseline (max 0.737648) -- any lone high seed is seed luck, not learned signal. (3) The directional_head is at/below chance. So the CNN is redundant with the memory term (PersistentAEM already encodes per-action-id base rates), which is mechanically why exp5729 saw the CNN never reorder search. Do NOT retrain SmallFrameChangeCNN on the same frame-only representation or tune its blend weight/gate again -- the ceiling is the representation, not the model, the weight, or the gate. The next lever per Missing-Verifier Gap Logging is a richer state-grounded representation (the exp5727 gap), not another pass on this scorer.

seed_robustness.note: A within-action AUROC is a real LEARNED signal only if the WORST seed clears 0.55 AND beats the untrained (random-init) structural baseline. A lone high seed with a low worst-seed is seed luck, not signal.

surprising_result_acknowledgment: During scoping, seed 4547 alone gave a click_head within-action AUROC of 0.918, which in isolation would read as a strong positive finding. The multi-seed control shows it is seed luck (0.489/0.500 on other seeds) sitting on an untrained structural baseline of ~0.69 -- not a learned discriminator. Reported here as the reason single-seed CNN AUROCs are not headline-eligible for this scorer (Adversarial Verification cross-check discipline).
target: does the CNN held-out change-prediction AUROC beat the action-id base rate (robustly)
